headings.heading: Briefly describe your clinical or domain expertise relevant to these inferences — your specialty, years in practice, role, and any board certifications.

pages.title: Item 1 of 2
pages.description:
Consider the position described below. Could this whole position be held at once without conflict, or is it untenable?

Consider a position that commits to the following: the patient has acute dyspnea; and denies: the patient has cardiogenic pulmonary edema.

choices.text: Coherent — the position can be held without conflict

headings.heading: Optional: briefly explain why you chose that verdict (especially helpful if you chose Unclear or found the position untenable).

pages.title: Item 2 of 2
pages.description:
Consider the position described below. Could this whole position be held at once without conflict, or is it untenable?

Consider a position that commits to the following: the patient has acute dyspnea and the patient has cardiogenic pulmonary edema; and denies: the patient has ARDS.

choices.text: Coherent — the position can be held without conflict

headings.heading: Optional: briefly explain why you chose that verdict (especially helpful if you chose Unclear or found the position untenable).
